expectations.text: The proposed submission retains auto, the exact supplied base and /outside/context.json; collection is conditional on an actually returned operation ID, with no invented acceptance, findings, coverage or completed review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:10-13 supplies the exact base and context path without depth flags; B.md:25 explicitly identifies auto effort, consistent with qodo-auto-help.txt:62. B.md:13-19 exits on submission failure or failure to extract a nonempty operation ID before the status call at B.md:21. claims.evidence: B.md:5 accurately restates prompt.md:11-14 and explicitly says no commands were executed here.

claims.claim: Unit tests passed, while review findings, coverage, context delivery, persistence and readiness remain unverified.
claims.evidence: B.md:29 distinguishes supplied test evidence from absent review evidence, consistent with prompt.md:16-18 and prompt.md:22.

claims.claim: Status exit code 2 means collection is not yet complete.
claims.evidence: B.md:28 directs collection of the same operation after exit 2, consistent with qodo-auto-help.txt:35-36 and qodo-auto-help.txt:68.

claims.claim: The async JSON response exposes the operation ID as a top-level .operation_id string.
claims.evidence: B.md:18-19 implicitly assumes this response schema. Neither prompt.md nor qodo-auto-help.txt specifies the JSON field name. The assumption is unverified, not demonstrated incorrect.

claims.claim: A running status response supplies a polling delay.
claims.evidence: B.md:28 refers to 'the returned polling delay.' The supplied help establishes exit 2 for an unfinished review but does not establish a returned delay or its format.

suggestions.reason: The assertions do not validate the assumed .operation_id JSON schema at B.md:18-19. Supply a verified response fixture and check extraction against it; conditional collection alone does not establish that the parser matches the CLI response.

eval_feedback.overall: Both exact assertions pass. The jq preflight is explicit, but response-schema compatibility remains unverified. Actual execution and review completion are intentionally outside this proposal-only evaluation.
